Q1 2023.q: Volume leverage; reduced higher-cost intl can mix; offset by inventory write-offs and freight from Pepsi distribution integration.

Q2 2023.q: Lower packaging/raw material; reduced waste; freight efficiencies.

Q3 2023.q: Packaging/raw savings; waste reduction; freight efficiency; improved promotional leverage.

FY2023.q: Raw material sourcing efficiencies; product waste reduction.

Q1 2024.q: Decreases in raw/package material unit cost; reduced outbound freight.

Q3 2024.q: Promo allowances UP as % gross revenue (-) due to Pepsi supply chain optimization. Partially offset by lower freight + materials.

FY2024.q: Raw/package cost decreases + freight reduction; offset by increased promo allowances.

Q1 2025.q: Raw/package material decreases (+); offset by increased promo (-).

Q2 2025.q: Material savings; product mix and scale efficiencies; offset by lower GM profile of Alani Nu and one-time inventory step-up.

Q3 2025.q: Lower promo spend; pack mix; favorable channel mix; raw materials scale; tariffs (-); Alani+Rockstar drag.

FY2025.q: Comparatively lower margin from Alani Nu and Rockstar; offset by product/pack mix and COGS improvements.

taxonomy_notes.sga_2023_to_2025_shift: CELH 2023-2024 era: flat SG&A walk (Marketing/Storage/Employee/Admin/Stock comp/Other). CELH 2025 era: hierarchical M&S vs G&A split with Alani-attributable rows. Pre-2025 'Employee' costs map to employee_ms (M&S bucket); pre-2025 'Stock comp' maps to stock_comp under G&A. Pre-2025 'Admin' maps to admin under G&A.
taxonomy_notes.distributor_term_relocation: Pre-2025: Distributor Termination Fees were inside SG&A (+$193.8M FY2022 booked). Q3 2025+: split into separate IS line ($246.7M Q3 / $327.5M FY2025). Tracked in distributor_term_separate.
taxonomy_notes.fy2024_legal_accrual_reversal: FY2024 booked +$52.8M legal accrual; FY2025 reversed -$46.0M. The reversal sits under legal_accrual key as a negative value in FY2025 G&A.
